verdict.rationale: Typesense docs explicitly document Semantic Search alongside keyword search and ranking/relevance tuning, and its GitHub examples showcase a live 'Semantic / Hybrid search' demo on 300K HN comments, directly evidencing fused vector+keyword queries in a single request. Cloud offerings even provide GPU acceleration for embedding generation to support this workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of a hybrid (vector+keyword fusion) query (the probe only confirms typo-tolerant keyword search, not hybrid fusion), and no explicit code sample showing the combined query syntax in the evidence pack.
